This handsome boy is equal parts curious explorer and cozy companion. Max loves keeping an eye on everything around him (especially the food bowl!) and will reward you with sweet slow blinks once he decides you're part of his trusted circle. He's playful, observant, and has a charming personality that shines more each day. When he's not investigating new spaces or showing off his goofy side, he's happy relaxing nearby and enjoying the quiet life. Max would love a patient home where he can continue to blossom and be your loyal little shadow.
dog.name: Max
